title: Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Billing Quick Reference: Invoicing, Payment Terms, Late Charges and Refunds
content:
# Billing Quick Reference — Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

Figures used by the fleet billing desk for invoicing, remittance and late charges under the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease, by program tier.

## Invoicing and payment terms

Rental invoices issue on day 1 of the month in every tier. Payment terms are the calendar days after the invoice date by which a rental invoice is due; the late-charge grace is the calendar days after the invoice due date before a late charge applies.

| Program tier | Payment terms (calendar days after invoice date) | Late-charge grace (calendar days after due date) | One consolidated invoice for all units | Courtesy late-charge waivers per calendar year per master agreement |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Business Advantage | 15 | 5 | No | 0 |
| Kestrel Fleet Select | 20 | 5 | No | 1 |
| Kestrel Fleet Preferred | 25 | 10 | Yes | 1 |
| Kestrel Fleet Premier | 30 | 10 | Yes | 2 |
| Kestrel Fleet Enterprise | 30 | 15 | Yes | 2 |
| Kestrel National Fleet | 30 | 15 | Yes | 3 |

## Figures common to every tier

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Late-charge percentage | 1.5 percent of the past-due invoice amount |
| Late-charge minimum | 25 USD per past-due invoice |
| Accepted payment channels | ACH credit, ACH debit, wire, business check |
| Payment cutoff | 17:00 Central Time on a business day, for the payment to post that day |
| Refund of a remaining credit | within 30 calendar days |

## Points of reference

- The invoice issue day, the late-charge percentage, the late-charge minimum, the payment channels, the cutoff time and the refund period are the same in all six tiers; payment terms, grace, consolidated billing and the courtesy-waiver allowance differ.
- Kestrel Business Advantage carries no courtesy late-charge waiver allowance at all.
- **Hypothetical illustration.** An invoice dated on day 1 of a month for a Kestrel Fleet Preferred unit is due 25 calendar days later, on day 26, and its grace then runs a further 10 calendar days.
